provenance.label: New Haven coffee shops near campus
provenance.detail: Street addresses are the businesses' published locations. Coordinates are OpenStreetMap geocodes of those addresses. Hours are listed only where verified from the business's public listing; seat counts are unknown. Blue State Coffee closed permanently in November 2022; its former Wall Street and York Street cafes are now Common Grounds.

shops.name: Common Grounds
shops.description: Independent cafe on York Street in the Broadway shops. Espresso, pastries, two-tops and a window bar. Wifi and some outlets. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Atticus Bookstore Cafe
shops.description: Bookstore cafe on Chapel Street across from the Yale University Art Gallery. Counter seating and a communal table. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Book Trader Cafe
shops.description: Used-bookstore cafe on Chapel Street with indoor tables and a courtyard when it is warm. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Willoughby's Coffee & Tea
shops.description: Coffee roaster on Church Street. Published address 258 Church St. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Koffee?
shops.description: Cafe on Audubon Street. Published address 104 Audubon St. Seat count is not published.

shops.name: Common Grounds (Wall St)
shops.description: Campus coffee shop in the old Blue State spot, steps from Cross Campus and Bass. Big communal tables, plenty of outlets, loud during rush. Fine for a pair on laptops.

shops.name: Willoughby's Coffee & Tea (York St)
shops.description: New Haven's roaster since 1985. Excellent pour-over, few seats and few outlets, so best for a quick caffeine stop or a short one-on-one meeting.

shops.name: Poindexter Coffee
shops.description: Hotel-lobby cafe inside the Graduate by Hilton with generous study seating, breakfast, and a calmer vibe than the student cafes. Reliable outlets.

shops.name: Olmo
shops.description: New Haven-style bagel shop with a serious coffee program and cold brew. Quick and close to Hillhouse and Audubon; better for a breakfast meeting than a long session.

shops.name: MOTW Coffee and Pastries
shops.description: Bright specialty coffee and Arabic pastry cafe downtown with housemade chai. Welcoming for laptops, a few blocks south of Chapel.

shops.name: Arwa Yemeni Coffee
shops.description: Yemeni coffee house with spiced drinks and honey bread and a dedicated study-friendly room. Open late, near the Green and the Law School.

shops.name: Cafe Romeo
shops.description: East Rock neighborhood cafe with pastries, sandwiches, and a loyal grad-student crowd. Longer walk from campus; quieter on weekday afternoons.

shops.name: The Coffee Pedaler
shops.description: Specialty cafe east of downtown known for careful espresso and pour-over, welcoming to laptop workers. A real walk from central campus.

shops.name: ERO Cafe
shops.description: Wooster Square cafe next to Sally's with creative matcha drinks and breakfast. Cozy, small; better for a break than a marathon.
